ModMetaData.name: Jawa Patches (local)
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Local content + compatibility patches for the "crashed Factory ship / Jawa stowaways" gravship campaign. Self-authored, kept minimal and defensive. Each PATCH is wrapped in PatchOperationConditional so a missing target (mod not loaded, def renamed in an update) is a silent no-op instead of a red error. LOAD THIS LAST in the mod order (RimSort), after every mod it touches.
Currently contains: - Defs/WeatherDefs/SWDesertWeather.xml — four hazard weathers (sandstorm, dry sandstorm, red fog, red foggy rain) extracted from "Star Wars - Biomes Addon" (Ferreira312, WS 2298926362). Pure XML, no assembly: the mod's custom C# overlay classes were swapped for the vanilla fog overlay while keeping all gameplay fields (accuracy/move/wind/lightning). Sandstorm cuts ranged accuracy to 0.25; dry sandstorm adds lightning-started fires; red fog / foggy rain reduce accuracy (and, for the rain, move speed). - Patches/AnimalBiomeDuplicates_Fix.xml — removes 3 duplicate (biome, animal) registrations that crash BiomeDef.CommonalityOfAnimal(). Armadillo x AridShrubland and Armadillo x Desert (Beasts of the Rim's animal-side wildBiomes duplicating Odyssey's biome-side wildAnimals), and Titan x TropicalSwamp (the Titans mod lists the biome twice in its own def). Left unfixed these kill Choose Wild Animal Spawns outright, make Giddy-Up skip its animal-biome cache, and abort Biome Compatibility Project inside RimWorld's post-load queue. Detected by Utils/animal_inventory.py; re-run it after mod updates. Nothing is lost in-game — the biome-side registration still spawns the animal. - Patches/BiomeAnimalDanglingRefs_Fix.xml — the null-key sibling of the above. Primordial Geysers injects animals into its biome guarded on the mod name only, and five of the named PawnKindDefs do not exist here (Vanilla Animals Expanded drops badger/moose/muskox/porcupine when Odyssey is active, via IfModNotActive in its LoadFolders.xml; AA_WaywardMobileAssembler was removed from Alpha Animals). Each leaves a BiomeAnimalRecord with a null animal, and BiomeDef.CommonalityOfAnimal then throws ArgumentNullException on the null key — which is what kept Choose Wild Animal Spawns dead. Removing them costs nothing: they spawn nothing, and the biome already lists vanilla Porcupine and Moose. These nodes are created by another mod's patch at runtime, so they do not exist on disk and offline validators report zero matches; that is expected, and it is why this mod must load after Primordial Geysers. - Patches/SWCPZoomerIcon_Fix.xml — kills the last red error in the load. Star Wars KotOR Resources and Materials ships an AssetBundle reference it never packaged, so SWCP_VATS_Zoomer's custom Graphic_Zoomer returns a null Material and vanilla BuildableDef.ResolveIcon throws a NullReferenceException every launch. Verified from IL that exactly one def is responsible, and that BuildableDef's PostLoad lambda skips ResolveIcon entirely when uiIconPath is non-empty — so adding uiIconPath (512blank, a texture the mod already ships) makes the NRE structurally unreachable without changing any runtime behaviour. Note this is hygiene, not a rescue: the post-load queue does NOT abort on a failed action, contrary to what our notes long claimed. The two "Failed to load bundle" lines will remain; only the exception goes. - Patches/SWDesertWeather_Attach.xml — injects those weathers into hot/arid biomes (sandstorms) and volcanic/exotic biomes (red fog) via baseWeatherCommonalities. Conditional-wrapped per biome. Tune the commonality numbers there to taste.
